using JSON3
function sh(c) try strip(read(pipeline(ignorestatus(`bash -c $c`); stderr = stdout), String)) catch e "ERR " * string(e) end end
base = "/scratch/coop/drozda"
paths = [joinpath(base, "cudnn_env_stade"), joinpath(base, "cudnn_env_stade2")]
res = Dict{String,Any}()
res["before"] = Dict(p => (isdir(p) ? sh("du -sh '$p' 2>/dev/null | cut -f1") : "absent") for p in paths)
for p in paths
    # only the two exact directories, never a pattern
    if dirname(p) == base && basename(p) in ("cudnn_env_stade", "cudnn_env_stade2") && isdir(p) && !islink(p)
        rm(p; recursive = true, force = true)
    end
end
res["after"] = Dict(p => (ispath(p) ? "still there" : "gone") for p in paths)
res["others_in_base"] = sh("ls '$base' | head -30")
println(JSON3.write(res))
